title: Ethnicity as Desire
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Ethnicity as Desire provides an in-depth study of the political and ideological meanings of gay pornography shaped over the last 40 years. Focusing on the analysis of ethnic representation, it offers innovative research on pornography as a cultural genre, discussing the triangulation between coloniality, gender, and sexuality, the phenomena of post-national identities in Europe, and asking about the legacies of Orientalism and colonialism.
